name: @lowrider/server
description: Lowrider game server: rules, CSPRNG, rounds and the Grove Casino connection.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.mjs --packages=external --alias:@lowrider/shared=../../packages/shared/src --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning
